title: A Peek Behind the Curtain: Using Step-Around Prompt Engineering to Identify Bias and Misinformation in GenAI Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes and conceptually evaluates bias using 'step-around prompt engineering' (adversarial prompting designed to purposefully sidestep AI safety protocols and safeguards) to expose underlying societal, cultural, racial, and gender biases embedded in training data. The authors propose analytical methodologies such as sentiment analysis, corpus linguistics, and counterfactual prompting in conjunction with step-around prompts, though they deliberately refrain from publishing specific empirical measurements or outputs for ethical reasons.
